description: Source code for a reftable writer module, implementing functions for writing, flushing, and managing reftable data structures, including sections for references, reflogs, and object indices.

classes.name: obj_index_tree_node
classes.description: Node structure for object index tree, containing hash, offsets, and capacity info.

methods.name: writer_reftable_block_stats
methods.description: Returns statistics structure for a given block type.

methods.name: padded_write
methods.description: Writes data with optional padding, handling pending padding bytes.

methods.name: options_set_defaults
methods.description: Sets default options for reftable writing if not specified.

methods.name: writer_version
methods.description: Determines the version of the writer based on hash ID.

methods.name: writer_write_header
methods.description: Writes the reftable header to a buffer.

methods.name: writer_reinit_block_writer
methods.description: Reinitializes the block writer for a specific block type.

methods.name: reftable_writer_new
methods.description: Creates a new reftable writer instance with specified write and flush functions.

methods.name: reftable_writer_set_limits
methods.description: Sets minimum and maximum update index limits for the writer.

methods.name: writer_release
methods.description: Releases resources associated with the writer.

methods.name: reftable_writer_free
methods.description: Frees the reftable writer object.

methods.name: writer_index_hash
methods.description: Hashes a record's hash and updates the object index tree.

methods.name: writer_add_record
methods.description: Adds a record to the current block, flushing if necessary.

methods.name: reftable_writer_add_ref
methods.description: Adds a reference record to the writer, updating index if needed.

methods.name: reftable_writer_add_refs
methods.description: Adds multiple reference records, sorting them first.

methods.name: reftable_writer_add_log_verbatim
methods.description: Adds a log record verbatim, finishing the public section if needed.

methods.name: reftable_writer_add_log
methods.description: Adds a log record, processing message formatting.

methods.name: reftable_writer_add_logs
methods.description: Adds multiple log records, sorting them first.

methods.name: writer_finish_section
methods.description: Finalizes a section, writing index blocks and updating stats.

methods.name: update_common
methods.description: Updates the maximum common prefix size between object hashes.

methods.name: write_object_record
methods.description: Writes an object index record, handling block flushes if needed.

methods.name: object_record_free
methods.description: Frees resources associated with an object index node.

methods.name: writer_dump_object_index
methods.description: Dumps the object index tree into the reftable.

methods.name: writer_finish_public_section
methods.description: Finalizes the current public section, including object index dumping.

methods.name: reftable_writer_close
methods.description: Closes the writer, writing footer and releasing resources.

methods.name: writer_clear_index
methods.description: Clears the object index tree and associated resources.

methods.name: writer_flush_nonempty_block
methods.description: Flushes a non-empty block to storage, updating index records.

methods.name: writer_flush_block
methods.description: Flushes the current block if it contains data.
